¶Las jornadas de acuáticas son en fincas: The [[wildfowl days]] are on estates in West Norfolk, an hour from Stansted, with a local guide for each gun.
¶El búfalo es el que más organizamos: Mo: The [[buffalo]] is what we organise most: Mozambique, Tanzania, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe. The [[leopard]] we hunt in Namibia and Mozambique, always over bait. The [[lion]] is hunted on tracks in the Kalahari and in Limpopo.
¶El elefante se caza en Botswana y Sudáf: The [[elephant]] is hunted in Botswana and South Africa, and [[rhino]] can be added as a trophy in Limpopo, on request.
¶Búfalo en Mozambique y Sudáfrica, y leó: Buffalo in Mozambique and South Africa, and lion on tracks in Limpopo. You'll find it under [[bowhunting]].
¶Es nuestro destino recomendado. Hay lob: This is our recommended destination. There is [[wolf from a hide]] on the southern plains, 80 km from Skopje, with a one-to-one guide.
¶También batidas de lobo y jabalí con pe: Also [[driven hunts for wolf and boar]] with hounds in the centre of the country.
¶En Mongolia, batidas de lobos en la est: In Mongolia, [[driven wolf hunts]] on the steppe, with one wolf included.
¶Son los tres países que más recomendamo: These are the three countries we recommend most. In Mozambique we hunt in Coutada 10 at Marromeu, in the Zambezi Delta, with [[packages of 5]], [[7 or 10 days]].
¶En Tanzania, el especial búfalos de la: In Tanzania, the [[buffalo special]] in the Mlele Game Reserve includes two buffalo per hunter. In South Africa there is hard-bossed buffalo in Limpopo and buffalo on tracks in the Kalahari.
¶Cazamos el macho montés en una finca pr: We hunt Spanish ibex on a [[private estate in Gredos]], with horses, a guide and airport pick-up.
¶Es uno de los grandes retos del arco en: It is one of the great bowhunting challenges in Spain. The [[bow programme]] is on the same estate.
¶Para un viaje corto, Europa del Este es: For a short trip, Eastern Europe is hard to beat: [[roe deer]] priced by weight in Hungary and Poland, [[red deer]] in the rut in Romania and Belarus, [[chamois]] in the Carpathians and the Balkans, and [[bear]] in Romania and Croatia.
¶Si busca algo más lejos, en Asia Centra: If you want to go further afield, Central Asia has [[ibex]] and Marco Polo. In Africa, the [[antelope]] of Namibia and South Africa. In Canada and Greenland, [[moose, caribou and muskox]].
¶La berrea de septiembre la cazamos en R: We hunt the September rut in [[Romania]], in Belarus with stags of 12 to 14 kg, in Bulgaria and in Austria.
¶En España, grandes venados a una hora d: In Spain, [[big red stags]] an hour from Madrid, with a gold-medal stag as the goal.
¶Los ciervos más grandes del mundo están: The biggest red stags in the world are in [[New Zealand]]. The roar there is in March and April.
¶Lo tiene en chanchos y antílopes, de ab: You'll find it under [[feral hogs and antelope]], from April to July.
¶En La Pampa, el programa general incluy: In La Pampa, the [[general programme]] includes blackbuck with red stag, wild boar, buffalo and puma.
¶En el sur de Mauritania, a 110 km de Nu: In the south of Mauritania, 110 km from Nouakchott, the [[warthog special]] includes five per hunter in four days.
¶En Mauritania los facocheros con arco s: In Mauritania, [[warthog with the bow]] are stalked morning and evening, closing in while they feed.
¶Lo más habitual es sumarlo al programa: It is usually added to the [[Limpopo general programme]] or to [[buffalo from a luxury lodge]].
¶Allí cazamos el muskox en primavera, so: There we hunt muskox [[in spring]], on frozen lakes, and [[in summer]] by helicopter.
¶El caribú de Narsarsuaq se caza en agos: The [[Narsarsuaq caribou]] is hunted in August and September.
¶La becada la cazamos en la montaña de S: We hunt [[woodcock]] in the Strandzha mountains in Bulgaria, over pointing dogs and with no bag limit. [[Capercaillie]] during the display in the Rhodopes, also in Bulgaria.
¶Para tirar a acuáticas y faisanes, West: For [[wildfowl and pheasant]] shooting, West Norfolk in England, an hour from Stansted.
¶El paquete económico incluye órix, dos: The [[budget package]] includes oryx, two springbok, baboon and jackal in four days. The [[Windhoek package]] is six days, one-to-one.
¶Botswana es uno de los grandes destinos: Botswana is one of Africa's great ivory destinations. The [[Botswana programme]] is ten days' hunting, the time a quality elephant needs.
¶En Limpopo cazamos el elefante desde un: In Limpopo we hunt elephant from a [[luxury lodge]], on private land next to the Kruger Park.
¶Desde allí se puede seguir con búfalo o: From there you can carry on with [[buffalo]] or plains game on the same trip.
¶En Hungría cazamos en la gran llanura,: In [[Hungary]] we hunt on the Great Plain, where the country's best roebuck are. In [[Poland]], from 11 May.
¶En España tenemos grandes corzos a una: In Spain we have [[big roebucks]] an hour from Madrid. And in Mongolia, the Siberian roe deer.
¶El programa de becadas no tiene límite: The [[woodcock programme]] has no bag limit.
¶En Macedonia, el rebeco balcánico se ca: In Macedonia, [[Balkan chamois]] are hunted in the alpine reserve of Karadzitza, with no points limit.
¶En Rumanía, el rebeco carpático es el m: In Romania, the [[Carpathian chamois]] is the biggest in the world in body and trophy. It is hunted between 1,500 and 2,400 metres.
¶Son pocos los países donde se puede caz: Very few countries allow cheetah hunting. In [[Namibia]] we ask for a minimum of six days.
¶En British Columbia cazamos puma, lince: In British Columbia we hunt [[cougar, lynx and bobcat]] with hounds, tracking by 4x4 and snowmobile. You need to be fit.
¶En La Pampa, el puma entra en el progra: In La Pampa, puma is part of the [[general programme in Argentina]].
¶El leopardo en Namibia se caza con ceba: The [[leopard in Namibia]] is hunted over bait, with a minimum of ten days.
¶El lodge está a 40 km del aeropuerto de: The lodge is 40 km from Windhoek airport, and it can be combined with [[antelope]] from the general programme.
¶En la Coutada 10 de Marromeu y en Nairo: In Coutada 10 at Marromeu and in Nairoto, leopard is part of the [[general programme]], of 7, 10 or 14 days.
There it is usually paired with [[buffalo]].
¶Rumanía tiene la mayor población de oso: Romania has the largest brown bear population in Europe, around 8,000. We hunt it [[from a hide]] and [[on drives]] in the Carpathians.
¶El programa del Kalahari permite añadir: The [[Kalahari programme]] lets you add buffalo on tracks.
¶Para el arquero, leones a la huella en: For the bowhunter, [[lion on tracks]] across 60,000 hectares next to the Kruger, with both lions and lionesses.
¶En el programa de muntjac y CWD van inc: The [[muntjac and CWD programme]] includes the guide, the rifle and the ammunition.
¶Entre abril y octubre, el muntjac se pu: Between April and October, muntjac can be added to the [[roe deer in England]].
¶En Tayikistán, el Marco Polo lleva un 1: In Tajikistan, [[Marco Polo]] hunting has had 100% success over the last 12 years, with average trophies of 55-56 inches.
¶En Nueva Zelanda, el tahr del Himalaya: In New Zealand, Himalayan tahr are hunted in the Southern Alps as part of the [[general programme]].
¶Y sin salir de España, el boc balear en: And without leaving Spain, the [[Balearic boc]] in Mallorca, all year round.
These are the two destinations we recommend. In Kazakhstan, [[Siberian ibex]] are hunted in the Dzungarian Alatau, Narynkol and Kegen, on foot and on horseback.
¶En Turquía, el íbex bezoar tiene trofeo: In Turkey, the [[bezoar ibex]] has trophies of 100 to 110 cm. November and December are the best months.
¶El urogallo se caza en celo en los Ródo: The [[capercaillie]] is hunted during the display in Bulgaria's Rhodope mountains, in conifer forest between 1,200 and 2,200 metres.
¶Es nuestro destino número uno para el j: This is our number one destination for wild boar. There are [[driven hunts in reserves]] for groups of 8 to 14 hunters and [[mixed hunting]], with drives and night stalking.
¶En el programa VIP nocturno la media de: On the [[VIP night]] programme, average tusk length is over 23 cm.
¶El gamo en Rumanía se caza en los paraj: [[Fallow deer in Romania]] are hunted on the grounds where "Fallow Buck Paradise" was filmed. A new national record was taken there in 2023.
¶En España, grandes muflones a una hora: In Spain, [[big mouflon]] an hour from Madrid, stalked in the rut or hunted from a hide.
¶Para búfalo en zonas salvajes, sin vall: For buffalo in wild, unfenced country we go to [[Mozambique]] (Coutada 10 in Marromeu, and Nairoto), [[Tanzania]], [[Zambia]] or [[Zimbabwe]]. We hunt elephant in [[Botswana]]. And for anyone looking for something different there is the forest of [[Cameroon]] and [[Benin]], or [[Mauritania]] and [[Tunisia]], two or three hours' flight from Spain.
¶Es nuestro programa general en Sudáfric: This is our general programme in South Africa: enormous private estates, a huge number of species and accommodation you will remember. From there you can also hunt hard-bossed [[buffalo]] and [[elephant]], and you can add a [[rhino]].
